_comment: Settings for index.html. Edit, save, reload the page - no rebuild on a symlink install. Rates are milliseconds between updates: 1000 = 1 Hz.
_render_comment: Background redraws per second. The map also redraws at once on every touch and on new data, so a low value does not make panning lag.
_colors_comment: Grid layers take rgb + alpha (0-255, 255 = opaque). Everything else takes a CSS colour.
_sizes_comment: Metres on the map, so they keep their real size when zooming.
_covariance_comment: Sent with Set pose. AMCL's own defaults: 0.5 m and 0.26 rad standard deviation, squared.

hints.view: drag to pan, pinch to zoom
hints.goal: drag from the target, release sets the heading - second finger cancels
hints.init: drag from where the robot really is - second finger cancels
